harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «فعسى ربي» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤتين» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; «يؤتين» is an accusative imperfect verb, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «خيرا» is a second mafʿūl bihi; the preposition «من جنتك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «طلبا».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وهي خاوية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «فيها»; the preposition «على عروشها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاوية»; «يا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ينصرونه» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and the clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the clause «لم تكن».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: His words «هنالك»: a demonstrative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الولاية»; the preposition «لله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الولاية»; «الحق» is a naʿt (adjective); «ثوابا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The preposition «ماء» [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase in the verse is «كماء»] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو كماء; and the clause «هي كماء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مثل الحياة الدنيا». The clause «تذروه الرياح» is a naʿt (adjective) of «هشيما».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير»; «ثوابا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the object of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «نُسَيِّر» is muḍāf ilayhi; «بارزة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وحشرناهم» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «نسيِّر», i.e.: We carry out the setting in motion in the state of Our gathering them. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «أحدا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وعرضوا» is conjoined to the clause {نُسَيِّرُ}; the clause «لقد جئتمونا» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by an omitted saying, which is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative [pronoun] of «عُرضوا», i.e.: they were presented, it being said to them. «كما»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), «ما» is maṣdariyya; «أول» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, being an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun); the implied form is: جئتمونا مجيئًا مثل خلقكم خلقا أول مرة (you have come to Us with a coming like Our creating you, a creating the first time). The clause «زعمتم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy [أنّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لن نجعل» is the khabar (predicate) of the lightened «أن»; the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «مشفقين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of المجرمين; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشفقين»; the preposition «فيه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ويقولون» is conjoined to the single word «مشفقين». «يا ويلتنا»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi. «ما لهذا الكتاب»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate); «الكتاب» is a badal (substitute); and the clause is the response to the vocative, which conveys lamentation. The clause «لا يغادر» is a ḥāl of «الكتاب». The clause «أحصاها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صغيرة»; the clause «ووجدوا» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يقولون»; «حاضرا» is a second object. The clause «ولا يَظْلم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (وإذ قلنا للملائكة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, the object of an implied اذكر (remember). The clause «كان» is resumptive. The interrogative clause is resumptive; «ذريته» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ; «أولياء» is a second object; the preposition «من دوني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولياء. The clause «وهم لكم عدو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ and the offspring; the preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «عدو». «بدلا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the clause of blame is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «عضدا»: the second object of «متخذ», and its first object is «المضلين» in position.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied اذكر (remember). The two objects of «زعمتم» are omitted, i.e.: زعمتموهم شركائي (you claimed them to be My partners). The clause «وجعلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يستجيبوا». His words «بينهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object, and «موبقا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أَنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ظن; the preposition «عنها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «وجد».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The two preposition and its genitive nouns: «للناس», [and] the preposition «من كل», are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرَّفْنا». The clause «وكان الإنسان أكثر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤمنوا» is the second object of «منع», as in: منعته النوم (I kept him from sleep); the verb «منع» is transitive by itself to two objects, or to the second object with «مِنْ». «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منع», and the clause «جاءهم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the maṣdar «أن تأتيهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «منع»; «قبلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «العذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «مبشرين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المرسلين»; the clause «ويجادل» is resumptive, and the clause «واتخذوا» is circumstantial. His words «وما أنذروا»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to «آياتي»; «هزوا» is the second object of «اتخذوا».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: His words «ومن أظلم»: the wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), [followed by] its khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «على قلوبهم» is attached to the second object of «جعلنا»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفقهوه» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: كراهة (out of dislike that). His words «في آذانهم وقرا»: the preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined to «على قلوبهم», and «وقرا» is a noun conjoined to «أكنة». The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «إنا جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «ذو»: a second khabar (predicate); the conditional clause is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ربك». The clause «لهم موعد» is resumptive; the clause «لن يجدوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «موعد»; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «القرى»: a badal (substitute), and the clause «أهلكناهم» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «لمَّا ظلموا» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: لمَّا ظلموا أهلكناهم (when they did wrong, We destroyed them). The clause «تلك القرى» is conjoined to the clause «ربك الغفور».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: (وإذ قال موسى لفتاه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied اذكر (remember). «أبرح» is an imperfect verb in the sense of أغادر (I leave off). «حقبا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أمضي».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «فلما بلغا» is conjoined to the implied clause اذكر; «بينهما» is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra; the clause «نسيا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سَرَبا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «لقد لقينا» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «هذا» is a demonstrative noun, naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «أرأيت» is in the sense of أخبرني (tell me), and its two objects are omitted, i.e.: أرأيت أمرنا ما عاقبته؟ (have you seen our affair — what is its outcome?). «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (عاقبته). The clause «فإني نسيت» is resumptive. His words «وما أنسانيه»: the wāw is parenthetical; «ما» is negating; a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied because [pronouncing it] is impossible; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is the second object; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أذكره» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from the hāʾ, i.e.: أنساني ذكره (made me forget mentioning it). The clause «اتخذ» is conjoined to the clause «إني نسيت». «عجبا» is a second object; the preposition «في البحر» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عجبا».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ما»: a relative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك». «نَبْغِ» is an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which was dropped in the script for lightening. The clause «فارتدا» is conjoined to the resumptive «قال». «قصصا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: قاصِّين (retracing).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The preposition «من عبادنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عبدا»; the preposition «من عندنا» is attached to a naʿt of رحمة.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: His words «على أن تُعَلّمن»: «على» is a preposition; «أنْ» makes [the verb] accusative; an imperfect verb, accusative with fatḥa; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ممَّا»: composed of the preposition «مِن» and the relative «ما», in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf, i.e.: كائنا على تعليمي (being [committed] to teaching me). «رشدا» is the second object of «تعلِّمنِ».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: His words «وكيف»: the wāw is a conjunction; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); «خبرا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the sense of the verb, since it has the force of «لم يخبره خبرا» (he did not come to know it by knowing). The clause «وكيف تصبر» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «ولا أعصي» is conjoined to the single word «صابرا», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The fāʾ in His words «فإن» is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن عزمت على الصبر (if you are resolved on patience); the clause «إن عزمت» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «إن اتبعتني» is the apodosis of the implied condition, and the clause «فلا تسألني» is the apodosis of the second condition. The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ذكرا».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The clause «لقد جئت» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «معي»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) in «تستطيع».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition «من أمري» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عسرا». «عُسْرًا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فقتله» is conjoined to the clause «لقيا»; the clause «قال» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قتلت»; the clause «لقد جئت» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The adverb «معي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) in «تستطيع».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The adverb «بعدها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «سألتك». «لدن» is an adverbial noun in the position of the genitive, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to «بلغت»; the second nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عذرا». The clause «قد بلغت» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «استطعما» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يُضَيّفوهما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يريد» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذ».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «بيني» is muḍāf ilayhi; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «سأنبئك» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl), and the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the clause «كانت» is the khabar (predicate); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أعيبها» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وكان وراءهم ملك» is conjoined to the clause «فكانت لمساكين». The clause «يأخذ» is a naʿt (adjective); «غصبا» is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The clause «فكان أبواه مؤمنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «الغلام». The masculine was given precedence in His words «أبواه», meaning his father and his mother; similar to it are: القمران (the two moons, i.e. sun and moon) and العُمَران (the two ʿUmars). The clause «فخشينا» is conjoined to the clause «كان أبواه»; «طغيانا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «فأردنا» is conjoined to the clause «خشينا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبدلهما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «خيرًا» is a second object; the preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرًا»; «زكاة» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «فكان لغلامين» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الجدار». The clause «فأراد ربك» is conjoined to the clause «كان لغلامين». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبلغا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. The clause «وما فعلته» is resumptive, and the preposition «عن أمري» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ. The clause «ذلك تأويل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «ويسألونك» is resumptive. The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ذكرًا», the object.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The two preposition and its genitive nouns «له» and «في الأرض» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «من كل» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سببا».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «فأتبع» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا}.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «وجدها» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the adverb «عندها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «وجد». The clause «قلنا» is resumptive. His words «إما أن تعذب»: [إما is] a particle of choice, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: choose: either your punishing them or your taking; the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first. The two objects of «تتخذ» are «حسنًا» and what the preposition «فيهم» is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «مَن»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ in His words «فسوف نعذبه» is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis, and the clause «سوف نعذبه» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَن». «عذابًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being: تعذيب.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «صالحًا»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فله جزاء الحسنى»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «جزاءً» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governor, its implied form being: يجزي جزاء; «الحسنى» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «يسرا» is the mafʿūl bihi. The preposition «من أمرنا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يسرا».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «ثم أتبع» is conjoined to its counterpart in verse (85).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; the preposition «من دونها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سترا».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: His words «كذلك»: the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive, [the phrase being] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر كذلك (the matter is thus). The wāw in «وقد» is resumptive; «لديه» is an adverb attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause); «خُبْرًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: أخبرنا خبرا. The clause «وقد أحطنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition «من دونهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قومًا»; the clause «لا يكادون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قومًا; and the clause «يفقهون» is the khabar (predicate) of كاد.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «فهل نجعل» is conjoined to the response to the vocative. The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تجعل» is genitive, attached to «نجعل»; «بيننا» is an adverb of place attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: His words «ما مَكَّنِّي»: «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is «خير». «مكَّنِّي»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied on the first nūn, its appearance being prevented by the assimilation of the verb's nūn into the nūn of protection (wiqāya). The preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «ربي» is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «فأعينوني» is resumptive, and the clause «أجعل» is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «آتوني»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the first object; «زُبَر» is the second object. «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause is resumptive. The second object of «آتوني» is implied, namely «قطرًا», by way of contention (tanāzuʿ) between «آتوني» and «أفرغ».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يظهروه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نقبا».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The preposition «من ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة; the conditional clause is conjoined to what is said (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause «وكان وعد» is conjoined to the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: His words «يومئذ»: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترك»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is for compensation. The clause «يموج» is the second object of «ترك». The preposition «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective); the preposition «عن ذكري» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «غطاء».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «أفحسب» is resumptive; the maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of حسب; the preposition «من دوني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولياء». The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to a ḥāl of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: «الذين»: a naʿt (adjective) of الأخسرين; the preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (سعيهم); the maṣdar «أنهم يحسبون» stands in place of the two objects of حسب; and the clause «وهم يحسبون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «فلا نقيم» is conjoined to the clause «حبطت». «وزنا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «ذلك جزاؤهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جزاؤهم».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {لَهُمْ}; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين; the preposition «عنها» is attached to a ḥāl of «حولا»; and the clause «لا يبغون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The preposition «لكلمات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مدادًا», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنفد» is muḍāf ilayhi. His words «ولو جئنا بمثله مددا»: the wāw is circumstantial; «مددا» is a tamyīz (specification); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the clause is circumstantial, and the circumstantial wāw is conjoined to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial) for the sake of comprehensiveness; the implied form is: the words of my Lord will not be exhausted in any state, even in this state.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «مثلكم»: a naʿt (adjective). Qualifying an indefinite with «مثلكم», though it is in construct, is permitted because it is an indefinite deeply steeped in vagueness that does not gain definiteness from the construct. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «يرجو» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «فليعمل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

mekki-muskil:103-103.t: His saying {بالأخسرين أعمالا}: أعمالا is accusative as a tamyīz (specification).

mekki-muskil:108-108.t: His saying {عَنْهَا حولا}: it is accusative by يبغون, i.e. a moving away (متحولا). One says حال من يحول حولا when one moves away from it.

mekki-muskil:59-59.t:
His saying {وَتلك الْقرى أهلكناهم}: تِلْكَ is in the position of the nominative (rafʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject), and أهلكناهم is the khabar (predicate). If you wish, تِلْكَ may be in the position of the accusative (naṣb) by an implied (muḍmar) verb which أهلكناهم explains.
His saying {لمهلكهم}: whoever reads it with fatḥa on the lām and the mīm makes it the maṣdar (verbal noun) of هَلَكُوا مهْلكا, and it is annexed (muḍāf) to the object, according to the dialect of those who allow هلك to be transitive; for whoever does not allow it to be transitive, it is annexed to the agent. Whoever reads it with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the lām makes it a noun of time, its implied form being "for the time of their destruction" (لوقت مهلكهم); and it is also said to be a maṣdar of هلك that came irregularly, like الْمرجع and الْمَحيض. Whoever reads it with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the lām makes it the maṣdar of أهلكوا (they were destroyed).

mekki-muskil:61-61.t: His saying {سربا}: a maṣdar (verbal noun); and it is said to be the second object of اتخذ.

mekki-muskil:63-63.t:
His saying {وَمَا أنسانيه إِلَّا الشَّيْطَان أَن أذكرهُ}: أَن is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from the hāʾ in أنسانيه, and it is a substitute of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl).
And His saying {فِي الْبَحْر عجبا}: it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) if you make it part of the speech of Mūsā (peace be upon him), and you pause on الْبَحْر; it is as though, when the young man of Mūsā said «and it took its way into the sea» (وَاتخذ سَبيله فِي الْبَحْر), Mūsā said: "I marvel a marvelling" (أعجب عجبا). If you make عجبا part of the speech of Mūsā's young man, it is the second object of اتخذ. It is also said that it is all from the speech of Mūsā (peace be upon him), its implied form being "and Mūsā took the way of the fish into the sea, marvelling a marvelling" (وَاتخذ مُوسَى سَبِيل الْحُوت فِي الْبَحْر تعجب عجبا); so pausing on عجبا according to this interpretation is good.

mekki-muskil:64-64.t: His saying {قصصا}: a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. they both went back following the track, a following (يقصان الْأَثر قصصا).

mekki-muskil:66-66.t: His saying {علمت رشدا}: رشدا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); its meaning is "May I follow you for the sake of right guidance, on condition that you teach me of what you have been taught?", so that على and what follows it is a ḥāl (circumstantial). It may also be the object of تعلمني, its implied form being "on condition that you teach me a matter possessing right guidance" (على أَن تعلمني أمرا ذَا رشد). الرُّشْد and الرَّشَد are two dialectal forms.

mekki-muskil:68-68.t: His saying {تحط بِهِ خَبرا}: خَبرا is a maṣdar (verbal noun), because the meaning of تحط بِهِ is "you have knowledge of it / are informed of it" (تخبره).

mekki-muskil:77-77.t: His saying {لاتخذت}: whoever reads the tāʾ light (without doubling) takes it from تخذت, and enters the lām that answers لو onto the tāʾ that is the first radical (fāʾ al-fiʿl) of the verb. The lexicographers report تخذت أَتَّخِذ, and Sībawayh reports استخذ فلَان أَرضًا ("so-and-so took land"), whose origin is اتخذ on the pattern افتعل, except that the first tāʾ was replaced by a sīn. Whoever reads it doubled makes it افتعل and assimilates the radical tāʾ into the augment tāʾ. Al-Akhfash said: the first tāʾ in اتخذ is a substitute for a wāw, and the wāw is a substitute for a hamza; and it is said: a substitute for a yāʾ, and the yāʾ a substitute for a hamza — Ibn Kaysān reported this from him.

mekki-muskil:86-86.t:
His saying {تغرب فِي عين}: it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in وجدهَا.
His saying {إِمَّا أَن تعذب وَإِمَّا أَن تتَّخذ فيهم}: أَن is in the position of the accusative in both; and it is said to be in the position of the nominative, which is clearer, on the sense of "as for it, it is …" (فَأَما هُوَ), as the poet said:
... فسيرا فَأَما حَاجَة تقضيانها ... وَإِمَّا مقيل صَالح وصديق ...
(So go on, the two of you: either a need you fulfil, or a good resting place and a friend.)
The nominative is by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), and the accusative is by an implied verb, i.e. "either you do the punishing" (فَأَما تفعل أَن تعذب), meaning "you carry out the punishment".

mekki-muskil:88-88.t: His saying {فَلهُ جَزَاء الْحسنى}: whoever reads جَزَاء in the nominative makes it a mubtadaʾ (subject) and له the khabar (predicate); its implied form is "for him is the reward of the best qualities" (فَلهُ جَزَاء الْخلال الْحسنى), so الْحسنى is in the position of the genitive (khafḍ) through the annexation of الْجَزَاء to it. It is also said to be in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from جَزَاء, the tanwīn having been dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; and الْحسنى on this view is Paradise, as though He said "for him is Paradise". Whoever reads جَزَاء in the accusative with tanwīn makes الْحسنى the mubtadaʾ and له the khabar, and جَزَاء is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being "for him are the [best] qualities as a reward" or "Paradise as a reward", i.e. being rewarded with it. It is also said that جَزَاء is accusative as a tamyīz (specification), and it is said: as a maṣdar. Whoever reads it in the accusative without tanwīn has only dropped the tanwīn because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and الْحسنى is in the position of the nominative; and there is remoteness (improbability) in this.

mekki-muskil:93-93.t: His saying {لَا يكادون يفقهُونَ}: whoever reads it with ḍamma on the yāʾ (يُفقِهون) assumes an omitted object, its implied form being "they can scarcely make anyone understand speech" (لَا يفقهُونَ أحدا قولا); and there is no omission with fatḥa on the yāʾ.

mekki-muskil:94-94.t: His saying {يَأْجُوج وَمَأْجُوج}: they are diptotes (not fully declined) because they are two names of two tribes, together with definiteness; and it is said: together with foreignness (ʿujma). Whoever pronounces them with hamza makes them Arabic, derived from أجيج النار (the blazing of fire), and from that is His saying مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ("salty and bitter"); so they are on the patterns يفعول and مفعول. It is also possible that whoever does not pronounce the hamza intends the hamza but lightened it, so that it is Arabic as well.

mekki-muskil:11-11.t: His saying {سِنِين}: accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), and {عددا} is a maṣdar (verbal noun). It has also been said it is a naʿt (adjective) of سنين in the sense of "possessing number". Al-Farrāʾ said its meaning is "counted (معدودة)", so on this view it is a naʿt of سنين.

mekki-muskil:12-12.t:
His saying {أحصى لما لَبِثُوا أمدا}: أمدا is accusative because it is the object of أحصى, as though He said: so that We may know whether these or those reckoned the term better [Translator's note: literally "whether these have reckoned the term or those"]. It has also been said it is accusative by لبثوا. Al-Zajjāj permitted making it accusative as a tamyīz (specification), and others disallowed it, because if one makes it accusative as a tamyīz, one makes أحصى a noun on the pattern afʿal (the elative), whereas أحصى is originally the form of the past from أحصى يحصي; Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said أَحْصَاهُ الله ونسوه and وأحصى كل شَيْء عددا. If it is established that it occurs as a past verb, it is impossible to use from it [the form] afʿal min kadhā ("more … than"); afʿal min kadhā always comes from the triliteral and never from the quadriliteral, except anomalously, as in their saying مَا أولاه للخير ("how given he is to good!") and مَا أعطَاهُ للدرهم ("how generous he is with the dirham!"), which is anomalous and not taken as a basis for analogy. Since afʿal min kadhā cannot come from the quadriliteral, it is known that أحصى is not afʿal min kadhā; it is only a past verb, and when it is a past verb the tamyīz does not come with it, and its passing [as transitive] to أمدا is clearer and more evident. If you make أمدا accusative by لبثوا, it is an adverb, but it obliges you to have made أحصى transitive with a preposition, because the implied form would be "reckoned their tarrying in the term", while it is among the verbs that do not need a preposition; so that is somewhat far-fetched, and making it accusative by أحصى is more fitting and stronger.
As for His saying {لنعلم أَي الحزبين} and His saying {فَلْينْظر أَيهَا أزكى}: the nominative in these, according to most grammarians, is as mubtadaʾ (subject), and what follows it is the khabar (predicate), and the verb is suspended (muʿallaq), not governing in wording. Sībawayh's reason for that is that, when the pronoun referring back to أيّ is omitted, it was made indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma. We will mention the explanation of the disagreement about أيّ in [Sūrat] Maryam.

mekki-muskil:14-14.t: His saying {شططا}: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being "an outrageous saying (قولا شططا)"; it is also permissible that the verb of saying makes it accusative.

mekki-muskil:16-16.t: His saying {وَإِذ اعتزلتموهم}: i.e. "and remember when you withdrew from them".

mekki-muskil:17-17.t: His saying {ذَات الْيَمين} and {ذَات الشمَال}: two adverbs (ẓarf).

mekki-muskil:18-18.t: His saying {فِرَارًا} and {رعْبًا}: both are accusative as tamyīz (specification).

mekki-muskil:2-2.t: His saying, the Exalted, {قيمًا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Book.

mekki-muskil:21-21.t: His saying {إِذْ يتنازعون}: the governor of إذ is ليعلموا.

mekki-muskil:22-22.t:
His saying {ثَلَاثَة}: i.e. "they are three", and likewise what follows it, five and seven.
His saying {وثامنهم كلبهم}: the wāw was brought here only to indicate the completion of the story and the end of what is related about them. Had it been brought with "fourth" and "sixth", it would have been permissible, and had it been dropped from "eighth", it would have been permissible, because the referring pronoun suffices in place of the wāw: you say رَأَيْت عمرا وَأَبوهُ جَالس ("I saw ʿAmr while his father was sitting"), and if you wish you drop the wāw, because of the hāʾ referring to ʿAmr. Had you said رَأَيْت عمرا وَبكر جَالس ("I saw ʿAmr while Bakr was sitting"), dropping the wāw would not be permissible, since there is no referent returning to ʿAmr. This wāw is called the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstance), and it is called the wāw of commencement (ibtidāʾ), and it is called the wāw of إذ, i.e. it means إذ; from it is His saying, the Exalted, ولطائفة قد أهمتهم أنفسهم.

mekki-muskil:25-25.t:
His saying {ثَلَاث مائَة سِنِين}: whoever gives nunation to مائة considered annexation to a plural far-fetched, because the basic rule of this number is to be annexed to a singular that makes its genus clear, as in عِنْدِي مائَة دِرْهَم ("I have a hundred dirhams") and مائة ثوب; so he gave nunation to مائة since a plural follows it, and made سنين accusative as a badal (substitute) from ثلاث. Al-Zajjāj said سنين is in the position of accusative as an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to ثلاث. It has also been said it is in the position of genitive as a badal from مائة, because it is in the meaning of مئين (hundreds).
Whoever does not give nunation annexes مائة to سنين, and this is the reading of Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī: they annexed it to the plural as they do to the singular. That was permissible for them because, when they annex it to a singular and say ثلثمِائة سنة, سنة means سنين, without disagreement about that; so they construed the speech according to its meaning. It is good in analogy, rare in usage, because the singular is lighter than the plural; it is far-fetched only in terms of the rarity of usage — otherwise it is the original.
His saying {وازدادوا تسعا}: تسعا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ازدادوا, not an adverb; its implied form is "and they added the tarrying of nine years". زاد is originally a verb that takes two objects; Allah, exalted be His mention, said وزدناهم هدى; but when faʿala turned into iftaʿala, it lost [some] transitivity and takes one object. The original of the first dāl in ازدادوا is the tāʾ of iftiʿāl, its origin being ازتيدوا: the yāʾ was turned into alif because it was vowelled and preceded by fatḥa, and the tāʾ was replaced by a dāl so that it would be voiced (jahr) like the dāl after it and the zāy before it. The dāl was more fitting for that because it is from the articulation point of the tāʾ, so the work of the tongue is from one place in articulation and voicing.

mekki-muskil:30-30.t: His saying {إِن الَّذين آمنُوا وَعمِلُوا الصَّالِحَات إِنَّا لَا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا}: the khabar (predicate) of the first إنّ is أُولَئِكَ لَهُم جنَّات. It has also been said its khabar is إِنَّا لَا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا, because its meaning is "We do not let their reward be lost". It has also been said the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "those who believe and do righteous deeds — Allah will recompense them for their deeds", indicated by His saying إِنَّا لَا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا.

mekki-muskil:31-31.t: His saying {من سندس}: it is a plural whose singular is سندسة. The singular of العبقري is عبقرية, and it is attributed to ʿAbqar; the singular of الرفرف is رفرفة, and the singular of الأرائك is أريكة.

mekki-muskil:39-39.t:
His saying {قلت مَا شَاءَ الله}: مَا is an incomplete noun (requiring a ṣila) meaning الذي, in the position of nominative on the implication of a mubtadaʾ (subject); its implied form is "you said: the matter is what Allah willed", i.e. what Allah willed it, then the hāʾ was omitted from the ṣila. It has also been said that مَا is conditional, a complete noun, with شاء in the place of يشاء and the answer omitted; its implied form is "you said: whatever Allah wills will be", and there is no implied hāʾ in this aspect, because مَا, when it is conditional or interrogative, is a complete noun that needs neither a ṣila nor a referent from a ṣila.
His saying {إِن ترن أَنا أقل}: أنا is a separating pronoun (faṣl) with no grammatical position, and أقل is the second object of ترني. If you wish, you may make أنا a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first-person pronoun in ترني. In speech the nominative of أقل is permissible: you make أنا a mubtadaʾ and أقل the khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of the second object of ترني.

mekki-muskil:41-41.t: His saying {غورا}: accusative because it is the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; its implied form is "[water] of sinking (ذَا غور)".

mekki-muskil:42-42.t:
His saying {وأحيط بثمره}: the object whose agent is not named (the deputy agent, nāʾib fāʿil) of أحيط is implied, namely the maṣdar (verbal noun). It is also permissible for بثمره to be in the position of nominative as the object of أحيط [standing in for the agent].
His saying {بثمره}: whoever reads it with two ḍammas (ثُمُره) makes it the plural of ثمرة, like خشبة and خُشُب. It may also be a plural of a plural, as though it were the plural of ثمار, like حمار and حُمُر, with ثمار the plural of ثمرة, like أكمة and إكام. Whoever reads it with two fatḥas (ثَمَره) makes it the plural of ثمرة, like خشبة and خَشَب. Whoever makes the second quiescent and gives ḍamma to the first (ثُمْره) does so for lightness, its origin being two ḍammas.

mekki-muskil:44-44.t:
His saying {هُنَالك الْولَايَة لله الْحق}: whoever puts الحق in the nominative makes الولاية a mubtadaʾ (subject) and هنالك its khabar (predicate), with الحق a naʿt (adjective) of الولاية; the governor of هنالك is the omitted [notion of] stability (istiqrār) in whose place هنالك stands. It is also permissible for لله to be the khabar of الولاية. Whoever puts الحق in the genitive makes it a naʿt of Allah, exalted be His mention, i.e. "for Allah, the Possessor of truth", and treats هنالك as non-governing; then the governor of هنالك is the [notion of] stability in whose place لله stands. Pausing on هنالك is not good in these two aspects. It is also permissible, when you make لله the khabar, for the governor of هنالك to be منتصرا [of the preceding verse], so pausing on هنالك is good on this aspect.
هنالك may be an adverb of time or an adverb of place, and its origin is place: you say "sit there (هُنَالك)", "here (هَاهُنَا)", "there (هُنَاكَ)", and "stay there (أقِم هُنَالك)". The lām in هنالك indicates the remoteness of what is pointed to.

mekki-muskil:47-47.t: His saying {وَيَوْم نسير الْجبَال}: the governor of يوم is an implied verb, its implied form being "and remember, O Muḥammad, the day We set the mountains in motion". It is not good for the governor to be what precedes it, because the conjunction prevents that.

mekki-muskil:48-48.t: His saying {على رَبك صفا}: [صفا is] accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:5-5.t:
His saying {كَبرت كلمة}: كلمة is accusative as an explanation (tafsīr, i.e. tamyīz), and in كبرت there is a pronoun as fāʿil (agent); its implied form is "grievous is their saying: Allah has taken a son". Whoever puts كلمة in the nominative makes كبرت mean "is enormous", and implies nothing in it, so the word is nominative as the agent of its verb, and تخرج is a naʿt (adjective) of the word.
His saying {إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كذبا}: إن means مَا (negation), and كذبا is accusative by the verb of saying.

mekki-muskil:50-50.t: His saying {إِلَّا إِبْلِيس}: accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), according to the doctrine of those who hold that Iblīs was not of the angels. It has also been said it is [an exception] from the first, because he was of the angels.

mekki-muskil:55-55.t:
His saying {وَمَا منع النَّاس أَن يُؤمنُوا}: أن is in the position of accusative as the object of منع.
His saying {إِلَّا أَن تأتيهم}: أن is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع.
His saying {الْعَذَاب قبلا}: whoever gives ḍamma to the qāf (قُبُلا) makes it the plural of قبيل, i.e. the torment comes to them group by group, i.e. rank by rank, i.e. in kinds. It has also been said its meaning is one thing after another of a single kind; so it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It has also been said its meaning is "face to face", i.e. it confronts them visibly, from where they see it. Likewise is the meaning in the reading of whoever gives kasra to the qāf (قِبَلا), i.e. it comes to them face to face, i.e. visibly. Abū Zayd related لقِيت فلَانا قِبَلا, ومقابلة, وقُبُلا, وقَبَلا, وقبيلا ("I met so-and-so face to face"), all with one meaning, i.e. visibly and face to face.

mekki-muskil:6-6.t: His saying {أسفا}: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:7-7.t: His saying {زِينَة لَهَا}: the second object of جعلنا, if you take it to mean "We made [it] become"; if you take it to mean "We created", you make زينة accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), because خلقنا takes only one object.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿هنالك الولاية لله الحق﴾: (هنالك) is a demonstrative in the position of accusative (naṣb) as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الولاية) is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the sense contained in the demonstrative, or to what it is attached to, namely the omitted khabar, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الولاية); and (الحق) is an adjective of (لله). Or the demonstrative is attached to the sense of settledness in ﴿لله﴾, (الولاية) is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar, i.e. "settled for Allah"; or they are attached to (الولاية) itself, since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning "support".
﴿هو خير ثوابا وخير عقبا﴾: (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), (خير) the khabar (predicate), and (ثوابًا) a tamyīz (specification); ﴿وخير عقبًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خير ثوابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿واضرب لهم مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء أنزلناه من السماء﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (اضرب) is an imperative verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اضرب﴾; ﴿مثل الحياة الدنيا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿كماء﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿ماء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أنزلناه من السماء﴾ is an adjective of (ماء). Or ﴿اضرب﴾ means "mention", so it takes a single object, and the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a striking like that of water".
﴿فاختلط به نبات الأرض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (اختلط) is a past verb; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اختلط﴾; and (نبات الأرض) is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فأصبح هشيما تذروه الرياح﴾: (فأصبح) is conjoined to (اختلط); the noun of (أصبح) is latent (mustatir), referring back to (نبات الأرض); (هشيمًا) is the khabar of (أصبح); and the clause ﴿تذروه الرياح﴾ is an adjective of His words (هشيمًا).
﴿وكان الله على كل شيء مقتدرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the Divine Name is the noun of (كان); (مقتدرًا) is the khabar of (كان); and ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مقتدرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿المال والبنون زينة الحياة الدنيا﴾: (المال) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (البنون) is conjoined to (المال); (زينة) is the khabar (predicate); (الحياة) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (الدنيا) is an adjective.
﴿والباقيات الصالحات خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير أملا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (الباقيات) is a mubtadaʾ; (الصالحات) an adjective; (خير) the khabar of (الباقيات); ﴿عند ربك﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ثوابًا) is a tamyīz (specification); and ﴿وخير أملًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خير ثوابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ويوم نسير الجبال﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿يوم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; (نسير) is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "We"; (الجبال) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿نسير﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وترى الأرض بارزة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ترى) is an imperfect verb; the fāʿil of (ترى) is latent, implied as "you"; (الأرض) is a mafʿūl bihi; (بارزة) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the preceding one.
﴿وحشرناهم فلم نغادر منهم أحدا﴾: the wāw here is circumstantial; (حشرناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "We carry out the moving [of the mountains] while gathering them, so that they witness those terrors with their own eyes"; or the wāw is conjunctive and the past tense is meant as future, i.e. "and We shall gather them". In ﴿فلم﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (نغادر) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, its fāʿil latent, implied as "We"; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, because it was [originally] an adjective of ﴿أحدًا﴾; and (أحدًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وعرضوا على ربك صفا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, joining to ﴿وحشرناهم﴾; (عرضوا) is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿على ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عرضوا﴾; and (صفًّا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the plural wāw in ﴿عرضوا﴾.
﴿لقد جئتمونا كما خلقناكم أول مرة﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئتمونا) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿كما﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or as a ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause has no grammatical position; ﴿أول مرة﴾ is accusative as an adverb, attached to ﴿خلقناكم﴾; and the clause ﴿لقد جئتمونا﴾ is circumstantial, or the object of an omitted "saying" (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل زعمتم ألن نجعل لكم موعدا﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (زعمتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أن) is lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (نجعل) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "We"; the clause ﴿لن نجعل...﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (أن); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, and (موعدًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نجعل﴾; or ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجعل﴾, taking (نجعل) in the sense of bringing into existence, and (موعدًا) is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ألن نجعل لكم﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿زعمتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ووضع الكتاب فترى المجرمين مشفقين مما فيه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (وضع) is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and (الكتاب) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); in ﴿فترى﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (ترى) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (المجرمين) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and (مشفقين) the second mafʿūl bihi, the seeing here being cognitive; or the seeing is visual and ﴿مشفقين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مشفقين﴾; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ويقولون يا ويلتنا مال هذا الكتاب لا يغادر صغيرة ولا كبيرة إلا أحصاها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and (يقولون) is conjoined; (يا) is a vocative particle and (ويلتنا) is the one addressed (munādā); ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (الكتاب) is a badal (substitute); the clause ﴿لا يغادر﴾ is circumstantial; (صغيرة) is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ولا كبيرة﴾ is conjoined to (صغيرة); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause ﴿أحصاها﴾ is an adjective of ﴿صغيرة﴾, or a second object of ﴿يغادر﴾, because it means "leave" and takes two objects.
﴿ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (وجدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause (عملوا) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "they found their deeds"; and (حاضرًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا يظلم ربك أحدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يظلم﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿ربك﴾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿أحدا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (للملائكة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قلنا); (اسجدوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لآدم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (اسجدوا); (فسجدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إلا) is a particle of exception; (إبليس) is the excepted (mustathnā); and the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ), and it is said: joined (muttaṣil).
﴿كان من الجن ففسق عن أمر ربه﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), implied as ﴿هو﴾, referring back to Iblīs; (من الجن) is the khabar (predicate); (ففسق) is conjoined to (كان); and (عن أمر ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (فسق).
﴿أفتتخذونه وذريته أولياء من دوني وهم لكم عدو بئس للظالمين بدلا﴾: the hamza is interrogative. (تتخذونه): an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وذريته﴾: the wāw is conjunctive. (ذريته): conjoined to the hāʾ; or the wāw means "with", and (ذريته) is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). (أولياء): a second mafʿūl bihi. (من دوني): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of (أولياء), or attached to ﴿تتخذونه﴾. ﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. (هم): mubtadaʾ (subject). (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was [originally] an adjective of (عدو). (عدو): khabar of ﴿هم﴾. The clause ﴿هم لكم عدو﴾ is a ḥāl of the object of (تتخذونه) or of its agent. (بئس): a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, its fāʿil a latent pronoun. (للظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (بدلًا): tamyīz (specification); and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, the implied form being: "How evil a substitute are Iblīs and his offspring".

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ما أشهدتهم خلق السماوات والأرض ولا خلق أنفسهم﴾: (ما) is negative; (أشهدتهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (خلق السماوات والأرض) is a second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿ولا خلق أنفسهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾.
﴿وما كنت متخذ المضلين عضدا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; in ﴿كنت﴾, (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and the tāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of (كان); (متخذ) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); (المضلين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (عضدًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿متخذ﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ويوم يقول نادوا شركائي الذين زعمتم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿يوم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (نادوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (شركائي) is a mafʿūl bihi; (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿زعمتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "whom you claimed to be partners", just as the second object of (زعمتم) is also omitted.
﴿فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وجعلنا بينهم موبقا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (دعوهم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فلم﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (يستجيبوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستجيبوا﴾; (جعلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بينهم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted second object; and ﴿موبقًا﴾ is the first object.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ورأى المجرمون النار﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فظنوا أنهم مواقعوها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (ظنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿هم﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); (مواقعوها) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause stands in place of the two objects of ﴿ظنوا﴾.
﴿ولم يجدوا عنها مصرفا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لم يجدوا) is conjoined to (ظنوا); ﴿عنها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مصرفًا﴾; and (مصرفًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرآن للناس من كل مثل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (صرفنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صرفنا﴾; (القرآن) is a badal (substitute) of ﴿هذا﴾; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صرفنا﴾; ﴿من كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted qualified noun, which is the object of ﴿صرفنا﴾, i.e. "a strange, wondrous meaning which resembles a parable (mathal) in its strangeness and novelty"; and ﴿مثل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الإنسان) is the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿أكثر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); ﴿شيء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿جدلًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وما منع الناس أن يؤمنوا إذ جاءهم الهدى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; (منع) is a past verb; (الناس) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يؤمنوا﴾ is the second object of ﴿منع﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منع﴾ or to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾; and the clause ﴿جاءهم الهدى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ويستغفروا ربهم إلا أن تأتيهم سنة الأولين أو يأتيهم العذاب قبلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (يستغفروا) is conjoined to (يؤمنوا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ربهم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن) and what falls within its scope is the fāʿil of (منع); (تأتيهم) is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (سنة الأولين) is a delayed fāʿil; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; (يأتيهم العذاب) is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم سنة الأولين﴾; ﴿قبلًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun or of (العذاب); and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed before ﴿أن تأتيهم سنة الأولين﴾, its implied form being "waiting for the coming", since the coming of the way [dealt with] the ancients cannot be made the thing that prevented them from believing.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وما نرسل المرسلين إلا مبشرين ومنذرين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; (نرسل) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); (المرسلين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (مبشرين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (منذرين) is conjoined.
﴿ويجادل الذين كفروا بالباطل ليدحضوا به الحق﴾: (يجادل) is an imperfect verb; (الذين) is the fāʿil; (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; ﴿بالباطل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾; in ﴿ليدحضوا﴾ the lām is causal, and (يدحضوا) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿يجادل﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدحضوا﴾; and (الحق) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واتخذوا آياتي وما أنذروا هزوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (اتخذوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (آياتي) is the first mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined to ﴿آياتي﴾, and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya and the maṣdar is conjoined to (آياتي); and (هزوًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن ذكر بآيات ربه فأعرض عنها ونسي ما قدمت يداه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن) is an interrogative noun with the meaning of negation, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) is the khabar (predicate); (ممن) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم); the clause ﴿ذكر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾ with no grammatical position; (بآيات ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ذكر); the clause ﴿ومَن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (فأعرض) is conjoined to (ذكر), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; (عنها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أعرض); (نسي) is conjoined to what precedes; (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; and (يداه) is the fāʿil.
﴿إنا جعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is the khabar of (إن); (على قلوبهم) is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of (جعلنا); (أكنة) is the first mafʿūl bihi; (أن) is a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle; (يفقهوه) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يفقهوه﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and ﴿في آذانهم وقرًا﴾ is conjoined to the two governed elements of (جعلنا).
﴿وإن تدعهم إلى الهدى فلن يهتدوا إذا أبدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تدعهم) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent, implied as "you", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; (إلى الهدى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تدعهم); (فلن): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (يهتدوا) is accusative by (لن), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إذًا) is a particle of answer and requital; and (أبدًا) is an adverb attached to (يهتدوا).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وربك الغفور ذو الرحمة لو يؤاخذهم بما كسبوا لعجل لهم العذاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ربك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الغفور) is the khabar (predicate); (ذو الرحمة) is a second khabar; the clause ﴿وربك الغفور﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (لو) is conditional; (يؤاخذهم) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤاخذهم﴾; the clause (كسبوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; the lām is connective (rābiṭa); (عجل) is a past verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عجل﴾; and (العذاب) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بل لهم موعد لن يجدوا من دونه موئلا﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿لهم﴾ is a fronted khabar; (موعد) is a delayed mubtadaʾ; (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (يجدوا) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (موئلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وتلك القرى أهلكناهم لما ظلموا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿تلك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), or accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb); (القرى) is a badal (substitute), and the clause (أهلكناهم) is the khabar (predicate); or ﴿القرى﴾ is the khabar, and the clause (أهلكناهم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar; ﴿لما﴾ is an adverb meaning "when", attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكناهم﴾; and the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿وجعلنا لمهلكهم موعدا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (جعلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لمهلكهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or attached to ﴿موعدًا﴾; (مهلكهم) is a mīm-maṣdar (verbal noun with prefixed mīm) put in construct with its agent; and (موعدًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وإذ قال موسى لفتاه لا أبرح حتى أبلغ مجمع البحرين أو أمضي حقبا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; ﴿قال موسى﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿قال موسى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لفتاه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; (لا) is negative; (أبرح) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun latent (mustatir), implied as "I", and its khabar (predicate) omitted, implied as "[I keep] travelling"; or ﴿أبرح﴾ is complete (tāmm) and so requires no khabar, i.e. "I will not leave off the travelling and seeking I am engaged in, nor part from it"; ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and genitive; (أبلغ) is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after (حتى), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition with its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أبرح﴾; (مجمع البحرين) is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿أمضي﴾ is conjoined to (أبلغ); and ﴿حقبًا﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿أمضي﴾.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فلما بلغا مجمع بينهما نسيا حوتهما فاتخذ سبيله في البحر سربا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لما) is an adverb meaning "when"; the clause ﴿بلغا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); (مجمع) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb put in construct with ﴿مجمع﴾; the clause ﴿نسيا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (لما); (حوتهما) is a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فاتخذ﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (اتخذ) is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "it", i.e. the fish; ﴿سبيله﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and (سربًا) the second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿فلما جاوزا قال لفتاه آتنا غداءنا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لما) is an adverb of time meaning "when"; the clause (جاوزا) is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it, and the object is omitted, i.e. "they passed beyond the place where they had forgotten the fish"; the clause ﴿قال لفتاه﴾ has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿آتنا غداءنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and (غداءنا) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿آتنا﴾.
﴿لقد لقينا من سفرنا هذا نصبا﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (لقينا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من سفرنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لقينا﴾; ﴿هذا﴾ is an adjective of ﴿سفرنا﴾ or a badal (substitute) of it; and ﴿نصبًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿لقينا﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال أرأيت إذ أوينا إلى الصخرة﴾: (أرأيت): the hamza is interrogative, and (رأيت) is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, the tāʾ being the fāʿil (agent); the two objects of (أرأيت) are omitted for brevity, i.e. "Have you considered our affair, what its outcome is?"; the clause (أوينا) is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; and (إلى الصخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوينا﴾.
﴿فإني نسيت الحوت﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason for the astonishment that came over them from what had befallen them; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); and the clause ﴿نسيت الحوت﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن).
﴿وما أنسانيه إلا الشيطان أن أذكره﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical between the conjoined element and what it is conjoined to, with no grammatical position; (ما) is negative; (أنسانيه) is a past verb, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the hāʾ the second mafʿūl bihi; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الشيطان) is the fāʿil of (أنسانيه); and (أن) with what falls within its scope is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of the hāʾ, i.e. "and none made me forget to mention it but Satan".
﴿واتخذ سبيله في البحر عجبا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (اتخذ) is a past verb conjoined to (نسيت), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "it", i.e. the fish; ﴿سبيله﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عجبا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿اتخذ﴾; ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اتخذ﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the first or second object; or ﴿عجبا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and ﴿في البحر﴾ is attached to an omitted second object of ﴿اتخذ﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قال ذلك ما كنا نبغ﴾: (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (ما) is the khabar (predicate); (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of (كان); the clause ﴿نبغي﴾ is the khabar of (كان); the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ذلك...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فارتدا على آثارهما قصصا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (ارتدا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على آثارهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ارتدا﴾; and ﴿قصصا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "retracing [their steps] a retracing", or a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "so they went back on their tracks, retracing".

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿فوجدا عبدا من عبادنا آتيناه رحمة من عندنا وعلمناه من لدنا علما﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿وجدا عبدًا﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من عبادنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿عبدًا﴾; the clause ﴿آتيناه﴾ is a second adjective; (رحمة) is a second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من عندنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿رحمة﴾; (علمناه) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من لدنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿علمًا﴾ and was placed before it; and (علمًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿علمناه﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿قال له موسى هل أتبعك على أن تعلمن مما علمت رشدا﴾: (قال) is a past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; (موسى) is the fāʿil (agent); (هل) is an interrogative particle; (أتبعك) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن تعلمني﴾: (أن) with what falls within its scope is in the position of genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in ﴿أتبعك﴾, i.e. "may I follow you, you being my teacher?"; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تعلمني﴾; the clause (علمت) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; and (رشدًا) is the second object of ﴿تعلمني﴾, since the yāʾ is the first object; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of right guidance"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿قال إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the kāf is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (تستطيع) is accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; the clause ﴿لن تستطيع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); ﴿معي﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "you being with me"; (صبرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿إنك...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وكيف تصبر على ما لم تحط به خبرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (تصبر) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تصبر﴾; the clause ﴿لم تحط﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تحط﴾; and ﴿خبرا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because (لم تحط) means "you have not had knowledge (lam takhbur)", or it is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent, i.e. "your knowledge has not encompassed it".

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿قال ستجدني إن شاء الله صابرا ولا أعصي لك أمرا﴾: ﴿ستجدني﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; (تجدني) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you", and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إن شاء الله﴾ is a parenthetical clause, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His words ﴿تجدني﴾. (صابرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تجدني﴾; the clause ﴿ولا أعصي لك أمرًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿صابرًا﴾ and so is in the position of accusative, or conjoined to ﴿ستجدني﴾; and ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿أمرًا﴾ and was placed before it.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿قال فإن اتبعتني فلا تسألني عن شيء حتى أحدث لك منه ذكرا﴾: in ﴿فإن﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (إن) is conditional; (اتبعتني) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); (لا) is prohibitive; (تسألني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عن شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسألني﴾; (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (أحدث) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after (حتى), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition with its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تسألني﴾; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحدث﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ذكرًا﴾; (ذكرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and an omitted adjective must be supposed after ﴿شيء﴾, i.e. "a thing whose secret is hidden from you".

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا ركبا في السفينة خرقها﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿انطلقا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb of past time containing the sense of a condition; the clause ﴿ركبا في السفينة﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (خرقها) is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿خرقها﴾ is the answer of (إذا).
﴿قال أخرقتها لتغرق أهلها لقد جئت شيئا إمرا﴾: in ﴿أخرقتها﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and (خرقتها) is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿لتغرق﴾ the lām is causal, and (تغرق) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خرقتها﴾; (أهلها) is a mafʿūl bihi; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (إمرًا) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿قال ألم أقل إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: in ﴿ألم﴾ the hamza is interrogative and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; ﴿أقل﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; in ﴿إنك﴾, (إن) [is the particle] and the kāf its noun; (لن) is a particle of negation and accusative; (تستطيع) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, the sign of its accusative being the overt fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; ﴿معي﴾ is an adverb in the accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "you being with me", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صبرا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿لن تستطيع معي صبرًا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿قال لا تؤاخذني بما نسيت ولا ترهقني من أمري عسرا﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تؤاخذني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you", and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تؤاخذني﴾; ﴿نسيت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; ﴿من أمري﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿عسرًا﴾; and (عسرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ترهقني﴾.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا لقيا غلاما فقتله﴾: the fāʾ is for conjunction; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb of past time containing the sense of a condition; ﴿لقيا﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) [Translator's note: so in the source; إذا does not make its verb jussive, and the source itself goes on to say the clause is in the position of genitive], and the clause is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (غلامًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; and the clause ﴿فقتله﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لقيا﴾.
﴿قال أقتلت نفسا زكية بغير نفس لقد جئت شيئا نكرا﴾: the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the answer of (إذا); in ﴿أقتلت﴾ the hamza is interrogative and (قتلت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (نفسًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (زكية) is an adjective; ﴿بغير نفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent, i.e. "you killed him unjustly", or of the object, i.e. "you killed him, he being wronged", or attached to ﴿قتلت﴾; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (نكرًا) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿قال ألم أقل لك إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: (ألم): the hamza is interrogative and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (أقل): an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ﴿أقل﴾; (إنك): (إن) [is the particle] and the kāf its noun; (لن) is a particle of negation and accusative; (تستطيع) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by (لن), the sign of its accusative being the overt fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (معي) is an adverb in the accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to something omitted, i.e. "you being with me", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صبرا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿لن تستطيع معي صبرًا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿قال إن سألتك عن شيء بعدها فلا تصاحبني﴾: (إن) is conditional; (سألتك) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عن شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سألتك﴾; (بعدها) is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of (شيء); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is prohibitive; (تصاحبني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قد بلغت من لدني عذرا﴾: (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (بلغت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (من) is a preposition; (لدن) is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿بلغت﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿عذرًا﴾; and ﴿عذرًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا أتيا أهل قرية استطعما أهلها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing the sense of a condition; (أتيا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أهل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and (قرية) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿استطعما أهلها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (إذا); and it is said: the clause ﴿استطعما أهلها﴾ is an adjective of (قرية).
